title: Both attempts to 'call it a draw' between quarrelling companions (Osk/Vell over the drowned nave's records; Vell/Tamsin over the Old Court's rings) rolled a bare 2 on a d20 against a need of 4+, yet the miss text ('So close — that one nearly landed') implies a narrow failure regardless of how badly the roll actually missed by, undercutting the shown math.
where: The Drowned Nave / The Old Court, at Rest — 'call it a draw' will checks

evidence.quote: Both attempts to 'call it a draw' between quarrelling companions (Osk/Vell over the drowned nave's records; Vell/Tamsin over the Old Court's rings) rolled a bare 2 on a d20 against a need of 4+, yet the miss text ('So close — that one nearly landed') implies a narrow failure regardless of how badly the roll actually missed by, undercutting the shown math.

Both attempts to 'call it a draw' between quarrelling companions (Osk/Vell over the drowned nave's records; Vell/Tamsin over the Old Court's rings) rolled a bare 2 on a d20 against a need of 4+, yet the miss text ('So close — that one nearly landed') implies a narrow failure regardless of how badly the roll actually missed by, undercutting the shown math.
